item.title: TrueMinutes 0.8.1
item.description:
TrueMinutes 0.8.1 (build 202609271314)


Changes included in this automatic main release:


- Bump GitHub Actions to Node 24 (c3efe94)
- Authenticate release feed push (b9c65b1)
- Normalize Sparkle signing key for CI (a26fea8)
- Allow internal signing identity in CI (c954021)
- Import release signing identity as PKCS12 (f8f5c9b)
- Trust internal signing cert in release CI (1c11acf)
- Regenerate Xcode project for release (39df29e)
- Fix meeting policy tests for 0.8.1 (399c3a4)
- Fix Slack Calls mic sync and Meet leave auto-stop latch. (368fcc9)
- Fix leave auto-stop and mic follow latency for 0.8.1 (d8e311f)
- Harden Sparkle release publishing (17380a4)
- Fix macOS CI and release secret gating (79fca2a)
- Set app version to 0.8.0 (0bfb0f0)
- Include updater and AXObserver sources in the Xcode project. (fd77134)
- Automate Sparkle releases on merge to main. (6698220)
- Add Sparkle daily updates with changelog feed. (d7fa7f1)
- Drive meeting detection from AXObserver events. (6343f69)
- Cut idle CPU by adaptive meeting detection polling. (48b661c)
- Keep Whisper downloads alive in the background and default audio retention to 24 hours. (1f5edf3)
- Fix installed-model activation, browser mic latch, and leave auto-stop. (e0d4770)
